hook.screen: What if the Sun hit us?
hook.text: What if one solar storm cut your power for up to two years?

beats.text: Hour zero. A billion tons of the Sun fly straight at you. The solar storm lands in just seventeen hours.
Hour seventeen. Auroras glow as far south as Cuba. But power lines start carrying currents nobody put there.
Then satellites start falling. A tiny solar storm once took down thirty eight Starlinks. This one is far bigger.
